title: The Axolotl Tile Council
description: On Porch Color Day, the axolotls vote by dropping painted tiles into the courtyard basin. Cobalt is ahead by one.
alt: Pink and gold axolotls gather beneath blue-and-white arches as one places a blue floral tile in the basin beside yellow tiles.
pairing: An imagined spring holiday for choosing porch colors × an underwater axolotl council that votes with painted tiles
